Package au.csiro.pathling.terminology.store

Class ScannedResource

java.lang.Object
au.csiro.pathling.terminology.store.ScannedResource
public class ScannedResource extends Object
The cheap structural facts about a single FHIR resource, gathered by the streaming pre-scan before any content is written. The pre-scan reads only the leading metadata fields of each resource, so a scanned resource never holds content proportional to the source size.
Author:
John Grimes

    • ScannedResource

      public ScannedResource(@Nullable String resourceType, @Nullable String url, @Nullable String version, @Nonnull String entryName, long byteSize)
      Creates a scanned resource.
      Parameters:
      resourceType - the FHIR resourceType, or null if the source was not a FHIR resource
      url - the canonical URL, or null if absent
      version - the business version, or null if absent
      entryName - the file path or archive entry name, for routing and error messages
      byteSize - the byte size from the file status or archive entry header
